text: DSH Annotation（DSH Web 插件）：为回复、文件预览和 Diff 增加可追溯的批注流程。它在会话界面提供选区批注、侧栏记录和来源定位，并通过 Host 命令将批注随消息发送。主要功能包括选择回复文字添加备注、为官方文件和 Diff 添加整页或选区批注、管理草稿与附件、在会话中查看和重新定位记录。适合需要对模型输出逐条反馈、审阅代码差异或给文件内容留注释的 DSH Web 用户。无需额外 API Key；批注草稿保存在浏览器本地。

DSH Annotation adds notes to DSH Web replies, files, and diffs. Select text to annotate it, keep notes in a session record, and navigate back to each source. Attach notes to a message and submit through the Host command. No extra API key is needed; drafts stay in browser storage.

Can I annotate a file preview or a code diff inside DSH?
I need to send several review comments along with my next message.
DSH Annotation 的功能「回复选区批注」：在助手回复中选中文字创建带来源位置的批注，并可从记录跳回对应内容。
DSH Annotation 的功能「文件预览批注」：为官方文档预览中的选区或整份文件添加批注，保留来源信息以便定位。
DSH Annotation 的功能「Diff 批注」：在官方 Diff 审阅界面创建批注并从会话记录重新定位到对应差异。
DSH Annotation 的功能「批注随消息提交」：将批注批次编码后交给 Host 命令校验，并作为用户消息随 steer 或 followup 发送。
DSH Annotation feature “Reply notes”: Select reply text to save a note and revisit its source from the session record.
DSH Annotation 的“文件与 Diff 批注”：为预览或差异添加备注，并从记录返回来源。

dsh-annotation README · Summary：Select text in replies, diffs, or files → annotate → send with a message. Replies address each annotation in order, and source navigation makes notes easy to look up. A per-Session record keeps annotations and the current attachment selection together. The plugin sends notes with the official composer's text, images, and files; unsent work stays in the current browser.
dsh-annotation README · Summary：**Version 1.1.7 requires DSH `>=0.2.2-alpha.3`; verification targets master commit `8bd073392e`.** See [upgrading](#upgrading) before updating an older Host.

dsh-annotation README · Install and upgrade：The package is distributed through [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ruisenbai/dsh-annotation/releases/tag/v1.1.7), not npm. In **dsh-market**, find `ruisenbai/dsh-annotation` under Sessions & Messages, then install or update it. The catalog uses the release's stable tarball alias; check the offered version and Host requirement before proceeding.

dsh-annotation README · Manual installation：Install the fixed release into your `web` profile:

```bash
dsh --version
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ruisenbai/dsh-annotation/releases/download/v1.1.7/dsh-annotation.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web why dsh-annotation
```

dsh-annotation README · Manual installation：The Host must satisfy `>=0.2.2-alpha.3`; the final command must resolve `dsh-annotation@1.1.7`. For a custom profile, replace both occurrences of `web` with its name. Restart that profile's running Web Host, refresh the page, and check **Settings → Annotations**. Build instructions and executed verification results are in [Development](docs/development.md) and [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md).

dsh-annotation README · Manual installation：When [Codex UI](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) is enabled, annotation compatibility activates automatically to keep attached notes clear of the input text. No setting is required; disabling Codex UI restores the standard layout. See [Codex UI compatibility](docs/compatibility.md#codex-ui).

dsh-annotation README · Manual installation：Annotation controls follow the Host's theme, rounded corners, and panel materials. The selection toolbar, annotation editors, detail and attachment previews, and grouped-note menus use text one pixel smaller than the conversation body; ordinary tooltips retain their own size. New-note editors have 10px vertical padding, and their text fields grow with the text up to seven visible lines. Attached-note previews stay within the window, and narrow record panels place actions below the note text.

dsh-annotation README · Upgrading from an older Host：Update the Host to `0.2.2-alpha.3` or newer before installing 1.1.7. The supported Host family supplies the unified Quote text / Add annotation toolbar. Keep 1.1.6 on `0.2.2-alpha.2`, 1.1.5 on `0.2.1-rc.2`, and plugin 1.1.2 while using `0.2.1-alpha.2`, 1.1.1 on `0.2.1-alpha.1`, or 1.1.0 on the `0.2.0` family. Drafts, source bubbles, recycle-bin records, and frozen retries retain their existing data formats; do not clear browser storage as an upgrade step. dsh-annotation README · Supported sources：Whole-file notes require written feedback. Official Diff hover previews have no creation entry; use the sidebar. Source filters appear when the Session contains at least two types. File and Diff notes retain source identity, range coordinates, and quote context; temporary loading or navigation failures keep the saved record available.

dsh-annotation README · Create and edit notes：1. Select source text and choose **Add annotation**. In a reply, the Host shows one toolbar with **Quote text** and **Add annotation**: Quote text inserts the passage into the composer; Add annotation opens the note editor. Overlapping selections create separate notes.
2. Type in the editor below the selection. Enter or the check button saves; Shift+Enter adds a line break. Chinese input composition does not trigger an early save. The input grows from one to seven lines, then scrolls internally.
3. Explicitly save an empty selection note to mark only the source. For a blank new editor, the first two outside clicks shake it; the third cancels it. Typing in the composer also cancels a blank new editor. Canceling creates no record, bubble, attachment, or trash item. A nonempty new note saves on the third outside click.
4. Click a numbered bubble to open its note. Drafts can be edited; sent notes show their saved text and can be attached again. Canceling an edit keeps the saved note. A suspended unfinished edit is not sent.

dsh-annotation README · Create and edit notes：The bubble follows the last selected character and scrolls with its source. Its blue surface has a white outline and number: translucent and frosted at rest or on hover, opaque while its note or group menu is open, and frosted again after closing. Browsers without backdrop blur use an opaque fill. Nearby bubbles can share a group menu. Source text has no permanent fill or underline; hovering or activating the bubble highlights the quote.

dsh-annotation README · Records and attachments：New notes attach to the next message by default without opening the record. The composer's upper-left chip shows the attached count. Hover to preview quotes and opinions; click to expand or fold the record. The annotation button left of the model selector also opens or closes it. A conversation without annotations shows no empty record.

dsh-annotation README · Records and attachments：Each record row offers a paperclip to attach or detach, a pin to locate its source, editing for drafts, and deletion when the record is not locked by sending. Hover its text to inspect the quote, source type, creation entry, and saved context above the record, clear of its row actions. The chip also provides batch detachment and deletion controls on hover or keyboard focus. Detachment keeps the note; deletion moves it to the recycle bin.

dsh-annotation README · Records and attachments：Records show a total count and use the same attachment controls throughout. Delivery labels and status dots are hidden. All records are ordered newest-created first, including after reopening or changing the **All / Body / Diff / File** filter. Attaching or detaching a note keeps its row in place. Editing leaves creation order unchanged; source bubble numbers, submission order, and frozen retries are independent of display order.

dsh-annotation README · Send, resend, and retry：Use the official composer to send attached notes with optional text, images, and files. Regular slash commands keep their own behavior. Attachment and editing controls stay locked while the Host checks or sends the message. The sent user message shows an annotation count above its body: hover a single note to preview it and double-click to locate its source, or expand a multi-note count to inspect and locate individual notes. The record closes when all annotations are sent and none remains attached.

dsh-annotation README · Send, resend, and retry：Use any available note's paperclip to attach it again after sending. Its annotation ID and source bubble stay the same, and no duplicate record is created. Reply labels such as **Annotation 1** appear in blue bold text without an underline; hover to preview the note and click to locate its source.

dsh-annotation README · Send, resend, and retry：After a failed send, submit through the composer again to retry the saved batch, or choose **Discard** in the record to abandon that retry. A retry keeps the original notes, overall requirement, locale, target Session, and attachment order. After a refresh, reselect the same attachments if requested; the plugin refuses changed attachment identities. New edits and selections do not silently replace the saved batch. Queued or already accepted submissions are not sent again by stale retry actions.
dsh-annotation README · Send, resend, and retry：

dsh-annotation README · Delete and recover：Delete one record or the chip's attached batch to move the notes into the browser-local recycle bin. A successful deletion offers Undo. Sending or retry-locked notes must be released from that operation before deletion; the UI explains the lock. Deleting a sent record never edits the original Session message.

dsh-annotation README · Delete and recover：Open **Settings → Annotations → Recycle bin** to filter by Session and source type, inspect saved quotes and opinions, and restore records. Session labels use project and title metadata when available. Available source snapshots can be previewed, and saved files can be downloaded; when the complete source is unavailable, its status appears only in the recycle-bin details, and the saved quote remains usable. Permanent deletion and clearing the bin require confirmation. They remove local recycle-bin content, not sent Session messages.

| ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Enable annotations                   | Shows annotation UI and composer integration; disabling preserves local data |
| File-preview annotations             | Enables creation from official file previews                                 |

dsh-annotation README · Settings：Changes are staged until **Save**. **Discard** drops unsaved settings, and **Reset** restores the inherited/default value for an overridden field. Disabling a source entry preserves its existing records. Historical compact-summary and transcript-hiding settings have no active controls or effects.

dsh-annotation README · Settings：When dsh-market provides its public update API, the same card can check and install this plugin's update and show progress. Force is offered only after an eligible release-policy failure; rollback, page refresh, and Host restart depend on the capabilities returned by Market. Without that API, use **Settings → Plugin Market**. Annotation content is not included in update requests.

dsh-annotation README · Data and limitations：- Unsent drafts, suspended edits, retries, recycle-bin entries, and source snapshots stay in the current browser. They do not synchronize across browsers; clearing site data can remove them. Sent annotation records can be restored from Session history.
- Multiple tabs coordinate local writes and preserve conflicting edits. Corrupt or future-version data is retained with an error instead of being replaced by an empty state.
- A selection cannot cross assistant messages. Markdown, code, and table navigation depend on the Host's rendered content and available history. The plugin does not hide reasoning, tools, or other conversation content.
- Whole-file annotations require an opinion. Large selections ask for confirmation. The default submission limits are 100 annotations and 512 KiB of encoded payload; a profile can configure them.
- Archived Sessions have no active composer; create and attach notes in an editable Session.
- Historical Git Diff records remain read-only. Existing submitted protocols and Session messages are not rewritten during browser-data migration.
- DSH Web in Chromium is the tested browser target. Other browsers, opera
dsh-annotation README · Data and limitations：See [Privacy](docs/privacy.md) for local data and network requests, and [Data model](docs/data-model.md) for persistence and retry rules.

dsh-annotation README · Model experience：The composer sends the selected annotations as one user message, with each quote, opinion, source identity, and any overall request. The current UI asks for ordered answers to the notes. A source-only mark has no written opinion. Full local source snapshots are not automatically added to the model request.

dsh-annotation README · Model experience：Unsent notes add no model context. Each batch shares concise handling instructions and omits unused sections; grouping related notes shares this fixed cost. Submitted text and hidden markers occupy context while retained in model history. [Message formatting](docs/architecture.md#durable-representation) defines the retained fields and conditional instructions.

dsh-annotation README · Model experience：Replies carry hidden annotation association and completion markers so the plugin can link answers to their sources and recognize processed notes. The displayed text hides those markers while the Session log retains them. Missing or invalid acknowledgements leave the record unprocessed; a successful transport alone is not a model acknowledgement.
